text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Thank you for your hard work...!
choice_data_list: Good work today. You did well.
Good work today. You did great!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...
However, I have no intention of settling for merely placing.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Regrettably left in the dust.
One could say that is a page of history in itself, but—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Because where I'm aiming is set even higher.
choice_data_list: First, we need to review our methods.
First, we need to review our methods.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Because where I'm aiming is set even higher.
choice_data_list: First, we need to review our methods.
First, we need to review our methods.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes!
Next time, I will seize glory without fail!"
choice_data_list: Let's recharge our energy with some racetrack gourmet today, then.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“...So in order to prepare for tomorrow's training,
we're focusing on nutrition first.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we held a review session of the day
while savoring the racetrack gourmet food.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Taking today's results into account,
we'll need to increase our precision...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um...
If it's okay with you, would you like to talk on the way back?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
As soon as we get back, I want to
start training to address my shortcomings...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis's straight and earnest gaze
unwittingly struck a chord in my heart.
